question: Find a paper supporting an experimentally demonstrated method to improve SnO2-based n-i-p perovskite solar-cell performance. Verify that the paper actually studies an n-i-p SnO2 device before using it as evidence.

args.query: SELECT Cell_architecture, COUNT(*) AS n_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT Ref_DOI_number) AS n_papers FROM devices GROUP BY Cell_architecture ORDER BY n_devices DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT Ref_DOI_number) AS n_papers FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture = 'nip' AND ETL_stack_sequence LIKE '%SnO2%'
